title: ecbolium secundum
intro: Ecbolium secundum, commonly known as Hooker's spiny catchfly, is a plant species belonging to the family Orobanchaceae. The health benefits of Ecbolium secundum include its use in treating various health conditions such as fever, inflammation, and respiratory issues due to its expectorant properties. The therapeutic actions of Ecbolium secundum include its ability to act as an anti-inflammatory, antipyretic, and astringent, making it effective in treating various health conditions. The bioactive constituents of Ecbolium secundum include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and alkaloids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
